fields.observation_id: Stable HMAC pseudonym; salt private to the deployment
fields.entity: Claimed institution, not an accusation against that institution
fields.state: Label for the fixed city proxy; not all searchers in the state
fields.kind: organic, ad, local, autocomplete, paa, related or knowledge
fields.domain_token: HMAC of normalized registrable domain; hostname and URL omitted
fields.phone_tokens: HMACs of normalized phone identifiers; raw contacts omitted
fields.risk: Clamped rule score 0–100; not a fraud probability
fields.verdict: Conservative rule ladder; likely-fraud findings require campaign approval
fields.signals: Versioned rule signal codes; raw source text omitted
fields.rule_version: Scoring rules used for the current result
fields.synthetic: True means generated illustrative fixtures, never measured search findings

aggregation: Per-run position-weighted risky share, averaged over complete eligible runs. Exploratory 95% bootstrap clusters by query. Autocomplete, knowledge, PAA and related searches are excluded from the ranked exposure denominator. Runs with disputed or unreviewed ranked findings are withheld entirely. Failed and empty runs are data gaps.
privacy: Public exports exclude raw snippets, URLs, phone numbers, advertiser names, raw search archives and user lookup input. HMAC pseudonyms permit linkage and are not guaranteed anonymous. Admin-only raw archives retain collected public source evidence.
provenance: Every live run retains a redacted, compressed SerpApi response and its search ID. Demo runs originate from the deterministic fixture generator in seed.py.
